name: bench
advice: Budget: about 40 triangles (164 today, 4.1 times the budget): boxes and 6-sided prisms, detail in the texture; decals (drains, tree pits) as one textured quad on the footway.
Seat, back and two legs as boxes (Cidade Otimizada: 48).
Remove its 10 hidden triangles: faces inside another part or pressed face to face, never seen.
4 round part(s) (cylinders, prisms): thin ones as boxes without caps or 3-sided prisms and the fake rounded-corner shader; caps that touch another part left out.
36 bytes a vertex: quantize (position 3 x int16, normal as 2 x int8 octahedral, colour 4 x uint8): about 12-16 bytes (KHR_mesh_quantization).
